title: Missile & Rocket Motor Hardware
description: Cylindrical/conical thin-wall casings, flanged rings, domed end closures with polar bosses and attachment lugs
designPrinciples: Material: Grade 5 (Ti-6Al-4V) offers the best balance of strength, toughness, and weldability for rocket motor cases. Higher strength beta alloys for ultra-high pressure applications.
Form: Ring forgings for case sections and flanges. Plate rolled and welded for large-diameter cases. Spin forming for domed closures.
engineeringTrends: Process: CNC machining of mating flanges
Process: TIG / EB welding of case sections
comparisonNotes: Standards: AMS 4928 Grade 5, annealed, 100% X-ray of welds + hydrostatic proof test to 1.5x MEOP
relatedCapabilities: TIG / EB welding of case sections
